table.retrieve:
SELECT 
	ProductCode,
	ProductName=Name,
	ChasisNo,
	EngineNo,
	Model=(SELECT M.Name FROM Model M WHERE M.ModelCode=Product.ModelCode),
	Purpose=(SELECT P.Name FROM ProductPurpose P WHERE P.ProductPurposeCode=Product.ProductPurposeCode),
	ProductType=(SELECT P.Name FROM ProductType P WHERE P.ProductTypeCode=Product.ProductTypeCode),
	Colour=(SELECT C.Name FROM ItemColour C WHERE C.IColourCode =Product.IColourCode),
	Finalized,
	FinalizedOn,
	Acquired=Aquired,
	AcquiredOn=AquiredOn,
	Delivered,
	ProductCost= PurchasePrice + Transportation
FROM
	DBO.Product
WHERE 
	Finalized='Y' AND Delivered='N'
